programs.title: The Aviators S3 - "Night Time Flying"
programs.desc: Kurtis and Anthony take us night flying. Some say it's more beautiful... while others think it's more dangerous!

programs.title: The Aviators S3 - "Guardian Angels"
programs.desc: Experiencing an aviation emergency where the calm voice on the other end of the radio helps get our pilot out of trouble.

programs.title: The Aviators S3 - "Oxygen Lab"
programs.desc: Kurtis experiences oxygen deprivation in the High Altitude Lab at Embry Riddle University.

programs.title: The Aviators S3 - "T-28"
programs.desc: Profiling the U.S. Air Force and Navy training aircraft that also was flown during the Vietnam War.

programs.title: The Aviators S3 - "Aviaton Career Choices"
programs.desc: Anthony visits the University of North Dakota to learn some of the many other ways to make a living in the world of aviation besides being an airline pilot.

programs.title: The Aviators S3 - "Start up and Run Up"
programs.desc: Sara and Anthony run the checklists with us as we look at all the steps pilots take on the ground to make sure things go as planned in the air.
